description:
Extract structured JSON data matching a custom schema directly from any webpage. Extracts clean content and processes schema mapping via fast LLM parsing. Requires x402 micropayment (0.015 USDC on Base).

When to use: Scraping structured data (product specs, prices, jobs, articles) into clean JSON.
When NOT to use: Do NOT use for general open-ended chat without a defined schema.

Parameters:
- `url` (string, required): Target webpage URL.
- `schema` (object, required): JSON object describing fields or schema to extract.
- `instructions` (string, optional): Specific guidance for extraction.

instructions.description: Optional instructions for parsing or field formatting.

schema.description: Schema definition or list of fields to extract.

name: extract_json_from_web
